new: The 仕法書 speaks of the draw as the winner's event, «一鬮当リ之節者» (加藤 1998, 143), and the 連名帳 numbers thirteen rounds, one per year (一番 … 十三番, 143): one member draws the pot each round. 加藤's description (144): 毎年六月十七日に竹原屋平三郎宅で鬮取りがおこなわれ. RE-BASED 2026-10-14: the cell was articulated on 加藤's own prose; it now rests on the 仕法書 and 連名帳.

The labour-compensation asymmetry (a profit share exceeding the loss share, «מה נפשך אי פלגא באגר תרי תילתי בהפסד אי פלגא בהפסד תרי תילתי באגר», Rava at BT BM 68b-69a) tilts the ratio but does not remove downside exposure.

DISPUTED WITHIN THE SUGYA, ON THE PROFIT LIMB ONLY (noted 2026-10-14): on the Nehardean pelga milveh the manager may use that half as he likes, «השתא דאמרינן פלגא מלוה אי בעי למשתי ביה שכרא שפיר דמי»; Rava answers that it was given him to trade with, «כי יהבינא לך לאיעסוקי ביה ולא למשתי ביה שכרא» (BT BM 104b). Neither side touches the loss limb.

Mudawwana 3, 648: a stipulation that the investor work with the agent is «لَا خَيْرَ فِي هَذَا» 'la khayra fihi', the agent going to a fair wage; the investor's own sale of a slave-girl of the qirad «بَاطِلٌ، إلَّا أَنْ يُجِيزَهُ الْعَامِلُ» 'batil illa an yujizahu al-'amil'. READ WITH mudaraba MG2: one Islamic datum. PREVIOUS NOTE: NEW CELL 2026-10-12 (MG2 clarified 2026-10-11, ruling 3; ruled by MS in pass commenda-italian-recode-2026-10-12). SINGLE-PRINCIPAL: the mudarib conducts the venture within the mandate. Widened by the general authority clause, «وإذا قال رب المال للمضارب اعمل فيه برأيك» 'idha qala rabb al-mal li'l-mudarib i'mal fihi bi-ra'yika' (Mabsut 22, 48); narrowed by restriction, «ولو قال خذه مضاربة تعمل به في الكوفة … فعمل به في غير الكوفة فهو ضامن» 'wa-law qala khudhhu mudarabatan ta'malu bihi fi'l-Kufa ... fa-'amila bihi fi ghayr al-Kufa fa-huwa damin' - a restriction of place is binding and breach makes him liable, whereas «واعمل به في الكوفة» 'wa'mal bihi fi'l-Kufa' (with wa-) leaves him free to work where he wishes (ibid., 41). The restrictions are terms bounding the mandate, recorded here (ruling 3). Same value as commenda, comanda and isqa. Medium: one jurist, read first-hand.
